evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story requests creating a new game with name/description; unique functionality.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific invite-by-URL behavior and intent.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: This is specifically about starting a round with a single multi-line entry; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme exists for estimators, but actor/context (moderator) makes this a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Covers selection (including re-estimate) as moderator; although related to PP-013, it represents the broader selection action so is not flagged here.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from starting a round; adding items to the list is a different context and intent.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing existing items is distinct from add/select/start actions; no duplicate elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete operation for items is unique and not duplicated in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This describes showing estimates immediately even if not all have voted, which is distinct from other reveal behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Specific acceptance-by-average behavior is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automated filling when all cards match is a distinct automation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is distinct from auto-fill or averaging behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by PP-005 which explicitly covers selecting items to be re-estimated; both have same actor and context (moderator re-estimation).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import functionality is distinct from copy/paste; not a duplicate of PP-015 (different UI/interaction).

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste approach is a distinct mechanism from an import feature; thematic similarity is not enough to call duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is distinct from viewing a transcript or scrolling rounds; no duplicate story requests same capability.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a full transcript (stories and estimates) is distinct from browsing or exporting; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: HTML export is a specific format export requirement separate from viewing or CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is a distinct format requirement from HTML export or viewing transcript.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from login, edit, delete; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login functionality is distinct from account creation or management.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is unique among account stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a distinct requirement from creation or editing.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display preference is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is a distinct requirement; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting scoring scale is unique; no other story duplicates this business rule selection.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: This imposes a team-size limit on invitations; complementary to invitation mechanism but not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Estimator join flow complements invite-by-URL but is not the same requirement; no duplication.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator seeing the current item is distinct from moderator selection and other list-viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of all items is analogous to moderator view but actor difference makes it distinct.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: This indicates presence of a submitted estimate (who has voted); differs from showing mapping of values or final reveal.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Post-all-reveal behavior is distinct from immediate show or partial reveal options.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Functionally duplicates PP-041 which allows changing estimate while draw not completed; same actor and condition.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Requesting prior-estimate history is different from current-round reveal or presence indicators; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing mapping of who chose which value during current round differs from presence-of-vote or prior-history stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start visible to all is a distinct interactive feature; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior is a specific timer rule distinct from starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: In-session scrolling through prior rounds is distinct from browsing previous games or viewing full transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering across draws is a specific UI consistency requirement; unique.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Functionally duplicates PP-034; both allow changing estimate until draw completion with same actor/context.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Personal thumbnail by card is a unique UI feature not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a distinct developer requirement; no duplicate story requests same standards.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions is a unique documentation requirement not replicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is a unique technical implementation requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific browser compatibility targets are distinct from general standards or accessibility stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct non-functional requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness requirement is unique among backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a distinct internationalization requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement is unique and not duplicated in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page UX requirement is unique and not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization for research is a distinct privacy requirement; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Analytics/metrics requirement is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.
